title: tracker show --json
description: Everything about one item (DESIGN.md §3): its fields, verification records and history.

item.description: The item as this version of tracker reads it. A file written by a newer tracker can hold more, which warning names.

warning.description: Present only when the item's file holds top-level fields this version doesn't know or can't show in full, such as ones a newer tracker added. It names them, and item leaves them out or shows them changed.
